verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents some built-in automations that run without manual action: automated emails to employees when receipts or memos are missing (jeeves-docs-21), automated invoice payment and approval flows (jeeves-docs-27), and payments scheduled for a future date (jeeves-docs-30). These are fixed-purpose features with one-line marketing mentions, not a general automation builder; the MCP server and webhooks are building blocks for external agents and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation/rules builder, documentation of how automations are set up, triggered and monitored, AI-native or agentic background workflows run by Jeeves itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
